groups.title: Use
items: Confirm non-blocking outcomes after actions or system events.
Use one short message and optional supporting description.
Provide one optional action only when it directly recovers or undoes the event.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use Toast for blocking decisions, long instructions, field errors, or persistent alerts.
Do not stack many messages without grouping or queue rules.
Do not show fake dismiss or action controls in demos.

groups.title: Review
items: Check placement against navigation and primary actions.
Verify timer, dismiss, and action behavior.
